name: Layers tab creates new layers and modifies blend mode and visibility
description: Verify adding new layers, adjusting opacity, changing blend modes, and toggling visibility.

planSteps.description: Click the Layers tab button in the right inspector panel
Verify the layers header displays Layers (1)
Click the Add New Layer button (title 'Add New Layer') in the layer toolbar
Verify the layer count updates to Layers (2) and a second layer appears
Click the visibility toggle button on the active layer item
Verify the visibility toggle state updates
Select Multiply from the blend mode dropdown
Verify the blend mode dropdown shows Multiply as the selected value
